title: Gimme Gimme Gimme (A Man After Midnight)
notes: A disco song released in 1979. Agnetha Faltskog sang the lead vocals. Written by Benny Andersson and Bjorn Ulvaeus, inspired by Donna Summer's hit Hot Stuff.
